questions.question: The number of misprints found in books printed by three printing presses are recorded below. Use One-way ANOVA to test whether there is a significant difference. Press A Press B Press C 4 5 6 5 6 7 6 7 8 / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• Null Hypothesis: There is no significant difference between the means,
  • Alternate Hypothesis: At least one of the means is not equal - 1 mark
  • T=15+18+21=54, N=3+3+3=9, Correction Factor=T2/N= 324 - 2 marks
  • Total Sum of Squares=12 - 1 mark
  • Sum of Squares between Columns=6 - 1 mark
  • Error Sum of Squares=12-6=6 - 1 mark
  • Mean Sum of Squares(C)=6/2=3 - 0.5 mark
  • Mean Sum of Squares(E)=6/6=1 - 0.5 mark
  • F statistic=3 - 1 mark
  • F(2,6) at 5% level of significance=4.26 - 1 mark
  • Calculated value of F
  • - 1 mark

  • Alternate Hypothesis: Preference for type of music and age are dependent - 1 mark

  • 51.24 - 3 marks
  • Chi-square statistic=314.18 - 4 marks
  • ϰ2(4) at 5% level of significance=9.488 - 1 mark
  • Calculated value of Chi square >Tabled value of Chi square . Therefore, Reject Null
